node.title: Phylons Liquidity Orquestration
node.reading:
This paper reconstructs the coordination and execution architecture of JUBAP/Phylons from the 2018 design corpus and the supplied xbot source snapshot. The system did not treat a signal as an executable order. It separated contextual detection, local intent formation, shared-resource authorization, exchange commitment, and realized feedback. The code now verifies a substantial substrate beneath that design: user–exchange credentials, books and currencies, balance snapshots, resource allocations, capital instances, resource-utilization statistics, executable transactions, market-operation lifecycle records, request/response audit logs, an event-driven feed–strategy–broker loop, exchange-neutral order submission through CCXT, order-completion polling, and stop-loss/profit closure through an opposite order. The complete tf15→tf5→tf1 book-supervisor logic, HQ/LQ classification, cross-book netting, sell-first priority, proportional proration, A/B/C/D sale taxonomy, and rich partial-fill ledger remain design-grounded where their full implementation is not present in the supplied snapshot. The contribution is therefore not a claim of autonomous multi-agent trading or investment performance. It is a code-grounded account of an explicit coordination contract: detectors propose; local supervisors size; shared-liquidity governance authorizes; exchange adapters commit; operation records reconcile; and feedback changes the next cycle. This contract is interpretable, testable, and portable to other domains in which many local actors compete for scarce shared resources.

Keywords: multi-agent coordination; expert systems; liquidity orchestration; resource governance; exchange broker; event-driven execution; auditability; replay evaluation

JUBAP separated epistemic confidence from economic authority. The supplied code verifies the resource and execution substrate; the historical design specifies the richer multi-book coordination policy that can now be replayed as an explicit, playable algorithm.

Partial fills, reason-coded A/B/C/D inventory attribution, full HQ/LQ arbitration and tf15→tf5→tf1 quantity synchronization are retained as design-grounded mechanisms, not silently promoted to code-verified behavior.

relations: A stable object identity can support several operational views without collapsing their distinct permissions and responsibilities.
Una pieza física y una posición financiera no tienen el mismo régimen de fungibilidad ni custodia. La comparación es de modelado, no de regulación.
A proposal–reservation–authorization–commitment sequence could clarify the authority boundary of piece allocation.
El esquema de broker tiene partes verificadas y partes reconstruidas o propuestas; no afirmar que el flujo financiero completo estuviera implementado ni que ya exista en inventario.
A shared-resource intent layer could be tested for industrial deployment without importing financial allocation rules unchanged.
No trasladar automáticamente netting financiero ni una política de venta-compra al inventario industrial. Calidad, titularidad y prioridad contractual requieren reglas propias.
Policy-version and expiry checks could make the boundary between a planned assignment and an authorized action explicit.
El artículo Phylons separa sustrato verificado y diseño de supervisor; este patrón se propone para evaluación y no documenta ya un módulo Mobility OS.
Each transition from proposal to commitment can be qualified by its own evidence, authority and validity conditions.
Phylons reúne código, diseño y propuestas con distintos estados; no afirmar que todo el contrato EA ya estuviera implementado.
The Phylons lineage motivates later questions about when a previously useful signal loses its operating-context qualification.
El vínculo registra linaje declarado; no atribuye al sistema de 2018 un detector RA validado en 2026.
For a complementary reading, see [The predictive-factor and context substrate](https://jubap.net/phylons-predictive-factors-cascade/).
For a complementary reading, see [Expert-system envelopes and authorization boundaries](https://tegrity.ai/ai-integrity-architecture-toward-expert-system-envelopes-around-statistical-ai/).

La reflexión sobre obligaciones futuras analiza cómo se reserva capacidad. Phylons separa intención local y autorización de liquidez compartida: la lectura compara cómo reconocer la capacidad disponible antes de comprometerla.

La selección de iniciativas pregunta qué acción puede comenzar con personas, recursos y facultades reales. La orquestación de liquidez aporta una comparación operativa entre una intención y un compromiso autorizado sobre recursos compartidos.
